svg.title: Linear and logarithmic normalization of the same synthetic two-dimensional intensity field
svg.desc: Two panels use the same synthetic two-dimensional intensity field and the same perceptually uniform viridis colormap. Linear normalization emphasizes a bright central core, while logarithmic normalization also makes a faint companion feature visible. Both colorbars state that the intensity units are arbitrary.
